title: What exactly is a LifeGroup?
description: LifeGroups create a space for people to intentionally share their lives with others, grow spiritually together, and encourage each other through the highs and lows of life. A LifeGroup Leader determines how often their group meets and what the focus of the group is. LifeGroups gather in homes, coffee shops, and other places where people love to connect—including online or through the Bible App.

title: How do i join a LiveGroup?
description:
First, give yourself a high five for taking the step to join a LifeGroup! Here are several easy ways to get connected:
Visit the Info Wall at any of our Karen Community locations and talk to the staff or volunteers there. If you attend Karen Community Online, talk to the volunteers in the chat area or contact the team here.
Find a LifeGroup near you or one that meets digitally using our online LifeGroups search tool.
Talk to someone you know who leads a LifeGroup and ask if their group is open to new members.

title: What do you actually do in a LifeGroup?
description: Every LifeGroup is unique. Some discuss the weekend message or content like the You’ve Heard It Said podcast, some complete Bible Plans in the YouVersion Bible App together, some serve together in the community, and some play board games or skateboard once a month. Two things you’ll find in every LifeGroup, though, are relationships and conversations that help people grow in their faith.

title: Is it okay to 'Shop Around for a Life Group'?
description: Absolutely! It’s understandable to want to find people you feel comfortable opening up to and developing friendships with. That being said, if you’ve joined a LifeGroup and aren’t sure if it’s the right fit for you, don’t give up. Keep in mind that there’s no such thing as a perfect LifeGroup because there are no perfect people. Remember to have grace and patience during the process. If it’s clear that this group isn’t the best fit for you, though, give another group a try.

title: What if there's not a LifeGroup for what I'm looking for?
description: This might be a sign that God is calling you to start a group! If God’s placed a certain passion or calling within you, He might want you to take a step of faith and launch a LifeGroup around it. You won’t have to do this alone, though. Your LifeGroups/LifeMissions team is here to support you every step of the way.

title: How do I start My own LifeGroup?
description: First, fill out our Volunteer Application. After that, your LifeGroups/LifeMissions team will reach out to help you prepare to lead your group. Then, you can invite people to your group and start meeting!

title: What if I don't feel qualified to be a Group Leader?
description: Don’t worry—you don’t have to a Bible scholar to lead a LifeGroup! We have lots of great resources to make leading a group as easy as possible, including conversation topics for your group, content to go through, tips for new leaders, and resources to help you develop and grow as a leader. You’ll also be connected to a Community Leader, who will be there to support you with prayer, resources, and encouragement along the way.

title: What if I have any other question about LifeGroups?
description: We’re here to help! If you attend a Karen Community location, connect with your LifeGroups/LifeMissions team or talk with a volunteer at the Info Wall on the weekend. If you attend Karen Community Online or don’t live near a physical location, connect with the Karen Community Online team.
